thread.title: Apple, P&G Boost Dow But Bears Hold Edge In Stock Market Today | Investor's Business Daily

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Apple, P&G Boost Dow But Bears Hold Edge In Stock Market Today | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major market indexes were lower after giving up early gains in the stock market today. The Dow Jones industrial average was holding up best, thanks to several stocks including Procter & Gamble and Apple.
X Blue chips kept the Dow near the flat line, while the S&P 500 gave up 0.3% and the Nasdaq fell 0.7%. Small caps lagged with the Russell 2000 down 1.1%. Volume was tracking lower on the NYSE and Nasdaq vs. the same time Wednesday.
On the Dow, Procter & Gamble ( PG ) gapped up and rose 2.4%. The consumer products giant is at a new high. Its relative strength line hit highs ahead of the stock, a bullish sign.
McDonald's ( MCD ), Exxon Mobil ( XOM ) and Apple ( AAPL ) also boosted the Dow with respective gains of 1% or more. Apple, which announced a $1 billion expansion of its Austin, Texas campus, is trying to climb off its Dec. 10 low. Shares are still 26% off their early October high.
Transportation, retail and apparel makers were among the biggest sector losers in the stock market today. But energy, automakers and homebuilders bucked the decline. Oil stocks outperformed as West Texas intermediate crude prices surged 1.5% to near $52 a barrel.
Tesla ( TSLA ) led automakers with a 1.4% advance. The Leaderboard stock remains in a buy zone after a breakout past a 366.85 cup-with-handle entry. Volume was light at the breakout, however, and continues to be lukewarm. Baird on Thursday raised its price target on the electric automaker to 465 and maintained an outperform rating.
Delta Air Lines ( DAL ) fell nearly 5% to drop below its 50-day and 200-day lines. The Atlanta-based carrier, which offered its 2019 revenue and profit outlook Thursday at its Investor Day presentation, disappointed some analysts . Last week, Delta lowered its Q4 unit revenue outlook.
Among other airlines, SkyWest ( SKYW ), Allegiant Travel ( ALGT ) and American Airlines ( AAL ) sank about 4% each.
REITs Rise In Stock Market Today Over in the IBD 50, Canada Goose ( GOOS ) led the downside with a 5% drop, almost giving back its big upside move from Wednesday. Shares of the Canadian premium outerwear designer have been bumping up against resistance at its 50-day line.
Health care plays also weighed on the IBD 50. Medpace Holdings ( MEDP ), Syneos Health ( SYNH ), Exelixis ( EXEL ) and PRA Health Sciences ( PRAH ) fell more than 3% apiece.
Several real estate investment trusts advanced, including Store Capital ( STOR ), Medical Properties Trust ( MPW ) and CareTrust REIT ( CTRE ). They climbed more than 1% each.
